# Qpure

> Qpure is an open-source macOS app manager and system cleaner fork of PureMac, focused on a complete Simplified and Traditional Chinese interface.

Qpure includes an app uninstaller, orphan finder, cleanup review, duplicate finder, similar-photo review, storage explorer, app updates, performance inspection, and macOS protection audit. Destructive operations require review and confirmation.

## Install
- Releases: https://github.com/qg-hs/Qpure/releases/latest
- Apple Silicon (M-series): download the `Qpure-macOS-Apple-Silicon-<version>.dmg` asset.
- Intel: download the `Qpure-macOS-Intel-<version>.dmg` asset.
- Requirements: macOS 13 (Ventura) or later.
- Each release also includes SHA-256 checksum files.

## Project
- Source: https://github.com/qg-hs/Qpure
- License: MIT
- Localization: Simplified Chinese (`zh-Hans`) and Traditional Chinese (`zh-Hant`), plus English and other existing locales.
